result.title: Benchmarking Fine-Grained Visual Reasoning for Remote Sensing in Urban Management
result.comment: Accepted by IEEE AP-GARSS 2026; 4 pages, 3 figures, 3 tables
result.summary: Fine-grained visual reasoning is essential for remote sensing in urban management, yet remains underexplored in the evaluation of multimodal large language models (MLLMs). We introduce UMBench, a fine-grained urban remote sensing benchmark built from unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) images for multiple urban management tasks such as traffic monitoring, urban construction, environmental quality, and disaster warning. Evaluations on UMBench reveal that current MLLMs often rely on scene-level priors and overlook fine-grained visual evidence. To address this issue, we further propose a novel evidence-first chain-of-thought method that directs models to inspect fine-grained visual evidence in a training-free manner. Experiments show that our method can improve the performance of both open-source and commercial MLLMs on UMBench.

AI.brief_summary: 论文构建了基于无人机图像的细粒度城市管理遥感基准 UMBench，覆盖交通、城建、环境与灾害等任务，并据此诊断 MLLM 依赖场景先验、忽略细粒度视觉证据的问题，进而提出免训练的「证据优先」思维链提示方法。
AI.relevance_reason: 直接涉及 VLM 细粒度视觉证据的保留与使用，其「场景先验替代证据」诊断和证据优先的 LOOK 式提示可供核查细粒度证据筛选与推理收益的联系。
